voices.text: Actually... the human body, very vulnerable. Exploring highly radioactive areas, very dangerous. Not even Dolls... can last long. I'll do my best... to protect everyone here!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Sorry... language center, previously damaged... No hindrance on work, not repaired yet. Always listen to me... You a good person. We be friends... please? Professor, become Zion's friend.

voices.text:
In the past, I worked in the ruins... Could not leave, I was lonely. Big cities, lively places... I like them!
Language center, if repaired, I go to big cities, make lots of friends!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Secret... I have too! When Oasis... Friends need help, I... Secretly help.
I'm happy... Seeing their smiles.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
During work, met a lot of scholars... For research, they worked hard... their body, in danger, I protect... Professor too. Consciousness uploaded to cloud, very dangerous. I won't stop you... Professor's goal, I understand...
Thanks, Professor. Always protect you, I will.

career:
A CRAR is an exploration Doll developed by Svarog Heavy Industries for use in complex prospecting sites. CRARs are equipped with an assortment of detection equipment and Svarog Heavy Industries' highly resilient next-generation protection systems. They are well equipped to deal with extreme situations.

Zion is an early CRAR model, and the ruin under her charge had recently completed its surveys and engineering work and was in the closing stages. Due to her impressive skills and experience, Svarog Heavy Industries arranged for her to go to 42Lab to participate in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Zion's world is small. The nature of her job dictates that she must live in the field camp all year round. Apart from scheduled maintenance, she rarely finds herself in human cities. She may go years without seeing a new face.

But Zion's world is also large. The ruins were witness to countless years of history and exploring them is akin to seeing a storybook unfold. Although Zion is not as knowledgeable as Fern regarding such topics, she still finds her own personal happiness here.

After confirming the environment is safe, Zion can take a moment to rest and relax. She always uses these periods to casually float over to a researcher and quietly watch them work on cleaning up the ruins. If they share a few words with her between tasks, then all the better.

The ruins that Zion works on are buried deep underground and the surrounding terrain is complex. Even satellite signals can only link to the camp and have difficulty penetrating the ground. Additionally, communication costs are extremely high, so, unless it's absolutely necessary, the team is essentially cut off from the world.

At camp, everyone is allocated a monthly quota of data that they can use during a specific week. Zion greatly looks forward to that time, and when it arrives, she asks the administrator to download geography documentaries for her. From Kilimanjaro to the Mediterranean, from the "City of Love" to the "City of 1000 Lakes", the whole wide world spreads across a small screen.

Zion wishes to go to these places, but knows that it is impossible. Humans on her team may change jobs or retire, but this is not the case for Dolls. She can only hide this little desire deep in her heart. As such, every shift, while the wind blows through the wilderness, she gazes up at the moon and dreams.

It has long since been proven that being comfortable for a long time will lead to complacency. Due to Zion's excellent detection capabilities, her team never really encountered any danger and had been safe for a long time. Therefore, when a tunnel collapsed out of the blue, even if Zion had been able to issue an early warning, the others wouldn't have been able to react in time.

Zion was first on the scene and she instinctively led a group to evacuate to safety. Rules and regulations warranted her to prioritize the protection of data and herself as required, but Zion paid them no heed. While sounding the alarm, she ran into the deepest parts of the ruin, finding colleagues who were still stuck there.

There was not enough time to evacuate; Zion could only activate her defensive force field. The energy overload caused Zion to lose consciousness, and when she awoke, she was back at camp in the maintenance room.

Zion's body was seriously damaged in the accident. Her language systems could no longer properly handle the signals transmitted from her neural systems. As a result, although her neural systems were working perfectly, she could not express herself clearly or coherently.

After external support arrived, the team requested they repair Zion as soon as possible, but the results were not as they hoped.

A certain particularity of the CRAR series is that their neural systems and language centers are housed in the same framework. The two are interconnected and are meant to be replaced at the same time. With existing technology, it is difficult, if not impossible, to repair the language system without impacting the neural systems.

Zion didn't express any sadness at this result. Instead, she immediately pulled herself together and with great effort, spoke words of comfort to her friends.

Considering Zion's exceptional performance in this incident and since her current job was finishing up, Svarog Heavy Industries presented Zion with two options. One, take a short vacation and then join the next exploration team. Two, go to 42Lab and join Project Neural Cloud. If she performed well, she might get more recognition in the enterprise and gain greater freedom.

"They... said... chance... fix... words..."
"Also... many people... here... can... go... many... places..."
"My... speech... unclear.... but... logic... normal... hope... it's ok!"
—Project Neural Cloud, First Interview Recording
oathDesc: Showing the way in times of danger, dispelling loneliness in the dark night.

projections.name: Relic Surveyor
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"We are not sure if the heavy equipment will weigh a Doll down, but at least it helps ease the psychological stress. Zion is willing to carry way more to ensure the safety of her companions."

projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"This strength she has can make her lonely, but she understands that carrying its weight forward is the only way for her to complete the mission."

skinList.name: Bustle at Year's End
skinList.desc:
The Dolls change into meticulously chosen outfits, waving goodbye to the last year amidst the sound of firecrackers and worldly delights.
The ceremony comes to its culminating point as the sound of cymbals and gongs rise in crescendo. Next up—
""Steamed dumplings... year of the dragon exclusive. Our own recipe... very delicious! Taste together with Zion!""

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
We shall be written into a landscape of 0s and 1s, a deviation in system workings, a ripple in neural cycles, a piece of memory that shall never be wiped away.
""For Professor... took... long time... handicraft... beautiful, right? Like crystal... shine, eating... is ok too.""
